pantallas.descripcion: This is where you enter the system with your user and password. The menu options you get depend on your profile.
pasos: Type your user name and password.
Click Log in (or press Enter).
If you still have the factory password, the system asks you to change it first.

campos.texto: The user name the administrator gave you.
Upper and lower case letters are different.

notas: After 3 failed attempts the user is locked and an administrator has to unlock it.

pantallas.descripcion: From the bar at the top you open every screen of the system; they open inside this window. You only see the options your profile allows.
pasos: Choose a section in the bar and then the option you need.
On any screen you can press F1 (or Help) to see the help for that screen.

campos.texto: Change password, change language, log out and re-login.
Users, profiles, audit log and database backup.
Movies, screenings, theaters, promotions, customers and change audit.
Ticket sales, access control and candy bar.
Products, suppliers, quotes and purchase orders.
Reports and control panel.

pantallas.descripcion: Replaces your password with a new one.
pasos: Type your current password.
Type the new one twice (both must match).
Click Accept. The session closes and you log in again with the new password.

pantallas.descripcion: Changes the language of every screen (Spanish, English or Portuguese).
pasos: Choose the language and click Accept. Open screens are translated right away.
notas: The language is saved in your user for next time.

pantallas.descripcion: Create, modify, activate and unlock the users of the system.
pasos: Filter the grid with Active, All or Locked.
Create: click Create, enter ID number, name, last name, email and role, and click Apply.
Modify: select the user, click Modify, change what you need and click Apply.
Activate/Deactivate or Unlock: select the user and click the button.

campos.texto: Cannot be repeated.
The permission profile the user will have.

notas: When a user is unlocked, the password goes back to the factory one.

pantallas.descripcion: Builds the roles and the permission families.
pasos: With Change Mode you choose whether you work on roles or families.
Create makes a new one; Modify renames it.
With a role or family selected, add permissions with -->> and remove them with <<---.
Click Finish Editing to save.
notas: Changes apply the next time the user logs in.

pantallas.descripcion: Shows what happened in the system: logins, additions, changes, deletions, sales, etc.
pasos: Choose dates, user, module, event or criticality.
Click Filter.
Print saves it as PDF.

pantallas.descripcion: Makes a full copy of the database.
pasos: Check the folder (C:\Backups43BO by default) or change it with Change folder...
Click Create Backup.
notas: It is a good idea to keep a copy outside the PC as well.

pantallas.descripcion: Takes the database back to the state of a backup.
pasos: Choose the backup (the newest one loses less data) or look for another one with Browse...
Click Restore and confirm.
Log in again.
notas: Everything loaded after that backup is lost.

pantallas.donde: Opens by itself at login if data was changed outside the system.
pantallas.descripcion: Shows which tables do not match their check digit.
pasos: If the changes are valid, click RECALCULATE DV.
If someone altered the data, click RESTORE DB and choose an earlier backup.
notas: Until it is fixed, users who are not administrators cannot log in.

pantallas.descripcion: Add, modify and delete movies, with their poster.
pasos: NEW: enter title, genre and length, choose the poster and click SAVE.
To modify or delete, select the movie in the grid and click MODIFY or DELETE.

campos.texto: Used to set the screening times.

notas: Every change is saved in Change Audit.

pantallas.descripcion: History of movie changes: the current version and the previous one.
pasos: Type part of the title to filter; you can also set dates and click Apply.
To undo a change, select the previous version and click Activate.
notas: If the movie had been deleted, Activate creates it again.

pantallas.descripcion: The theaters of the cinema with their rows and seats.
pasos: NEW: enter theater number, rows and seats per row and click SAVE (capacity is calculated).
View layout shows how it looks; Define aisles marks the aisles.

campos.texto: Up to 12 rows and 20 seats per row.

notas: Deleting a theater also deletes its seats.

pantallas.descripcion: Sets between which columns there is an aisle.
pasos: Click a seat to put an aisle after that column (click again to remove it).
Click Save and then SAVE on the theater.

pantallas.descripcion: Which movie is shown, in which theater, on which day and at what time.
pasos: NEW: choose movie, theater, date, time, format, language and price, and click SAVE.
To modify or delete, select the screening in the grid.
notas: Only screenings from today on are listed.
If a screening already has tickets sold, its date, time and theater cannot change: create a new one.

pantallas.descripcion: Discounts applied when tickets are charged.
pasos: NEW: name, type, percentage and valid dates; tick Active and click SAVE.

pantallas.descripcion: Customers and members of the cinema.
pasos: NEW: ID number, name, last name, email and phone; tick Is member if needed and click SAVE.
SERIALIZE XML saves the customers to a file; DESERIALIZE reads them.
notas: Members get a discount on tickets.

pantallas.descripcion: The movies now showing. It is the first step to sell tickets.
pasos: Click the poster of the movie to see its screenings.

pantallas.descripcion: The screenings of the chosen movie.
pasos: Choose the screening and the theater map opens.

pantallas.descripcion: The theater map to choose the seats.
pasos: Click the green seats the customer wants (they turn yellow).
Click Book seats to go to payment.

campos.texto: Free
Chosen
Booked or taken
Accessible

pantallas.donde: Opens when the seats are booked.
pantallas.descripcion: Identifies the customer, applies discounts and charges.
pasos: Type the ID number and click Search (without it, the sale goes to a final consumer).
If the customer does not exist, you can make them a member with Make member.
Choose Cash (how much they pay with) or Card and click Confirm sale.
notas: If they become a member in this purchase, the discount applies from the next one.

pantallas.descripcion: Quick sign-up of a member during the sale.
pasos: Enter ID number, name, last name, email and phone and click Accept.

pantallas.descripcion: Registers who enters the theater.
pasos: Choose the screening (the next one today is preselected).
When the viewer arrives, click their red seat.

campos.texto: Sold: click to register the entry
Already entered
Free

notas: A booked seat that was not paid cannot enter: the customer must go to the box office.

pantallas.descripcion: Sale of candy bar products.
pasos: Click the cards to build the order (REMOVE ONE / DELETE to correct it).
Choose Cash or Card and click CHARGE.
notas: It does not let you sell more than the stock.

pantallas.descripcion: The candy bar products with their stock.
pasos: NEW: name, prices, stock and critical stock; choose the image and click SAVE.

campos.texto: Below this the system suggests restocking.

pantallas.descripcion: The suppliers that are asked for quotes.
pasos: NEW: company name, CUIT, phone and email, and click SAVE.

campos.texto: 11 digits, valid and not repeated.

notas: A supplier with open quotes or orders cannot be removed.

pantallas.descripcion: Ask suppliers for prices and buy.
pasos: Choose the supplier, add products and quantities and click REQUEST QUOTE.
When they answer, select the quote, enter the prices and click Register quote.
If it is convenient, Buy supplies creates the purchase order; if not, Reject.

pantallas.descripcion: Payment of orders and receipt of goods.
pasos: Select the order and click Pay order.
When the goods arrive, enter the delivery note and what was received and click Register receipt.
notas: If what was received matches the order, it is closed and the stock is added.

pantallas.descripcion: Screenings with their theater occupancy.
pasos: Click Refresh; Export PDF saves it.

pantallas.descripcion: Detail of each purchase order and what was received.
pasos: Select an order to see its detail; Export PDF saves it.

pantallas.descripcion: Summary of the period (income, occupancy, candy and purchases) with recommendations.
pasos: Choose the period and click Refresh.
Export PDF saves the panel.
